prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE tiny Victoria 3 ship designer equipment icon for wooden DECK AND PROVISION STOWAGE, no full ship. Input image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: native small painted metallic embossed equipment glyphs. Match thin dark bevel edge, simple broad silhouette, restrained metallic texture. A compact isolated simplified isometric wooden planked platform/deck fragment with provision casks, only 3 or 4 big essential shapes, readable at 32px. All parts in a SINGLE metallic tier palette (including planks and casks), no natural brown wood, white objects, text or scenic backdrop. Genuine transparent background outside glyph; opaque interiors, no aura, glow, bloom, haze, cast backdrop shadow, frame, badges, people, sails, mast, cannons, engines or sea. Keep complete icon inside canvas with generous transparent margins. Not a photorealistic illustration or detailed architectural drawing. LOW tier: warm copper BRONZE. One simple flat planked platform segment with ONE large hooped barrel and a smaller provision crate resting on it. A low rim suggests the existing hold. No raised deck or additional floor.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: one tiny Victoria 3 ship designer equipment glyph, SILVER middle tier, transparent background.
Input image 1: edit target. Remake this same quarterdeck and separate provision-store icon, correcting the inconsistent perspective in the lower/front platform, crate and front supports. Preserve its subject, compact stepped composition, blue-gray silver monochrome palette, painted embossed metallic style, thin dark outlines and sparse broad shapes.
Geometry correction: use ONE consistent orthographic isometric projection across every rectangular part. All edges belonging to the same direction are strictly parallel: vertical posts vertical, two horizontal axes at approximately +30 and -30 degrees. Upper deck and lower deck must be parallel rectangular planked platforms with consistent thickness. Upper raised quarterdeck covers the right/rear portion of the lower platform, which extends toward the left/front. Exactly four sturdy support posts stand directly under the four corresponding corners of the upper platform, all bases resting on the same lower platform plane. Upper deck corners and posts line up vertically, not offset or floating. One small square provision crate sits flat on the exposed lower-left/front platform; its top edges, plank edges, and side edges obey exactly the SAME isometric axes as both platforms. One large upright barrel rests on the lower platform beneath the right side of the upper deck. Leave the space under the raised deck open so supports, crate and barrel are unambiguous; do not draw a sloping rear wall that merges into the floor or crate. Keep a minimal rear railing on the upper deck. No extra objects.
Constraints: a game icon readable at 32 pixels, NOT a technical diagram or photorealistic scene. Silver-blue monochrome for everything, including wood and casks. Broad simple surfaces, restrained bevel highlights. Entire glyph centered with generous transparent margins, genuinely transparent empty background and gaps. No black background, glow, haze, aura, floor shadow, text, red annotations, frame, ship hull, sails, people, motors or cannons. Correct the geometry, not the palette or concept.
